rules.impact: Services may fail to write state, logs, or temporary data.
rules.rationale: Very high filesystem utilization can exhaust write capacity unexpectedly.
rules.recommendation: Confirm growth and retention expectations, then reclaim or add capacity through an approved maintenance workflow.
rules.title: Filesystem utilization is at or above 90%

rules.impact: Required host functionality may be unavailable or degraded.
rules.rationale: Failed units indicate services that did not reach their requested state.
rules.recommendation: Confirm whether each unit is required, then inspect status and logs through an approved drill-down collector.
rules.title: Systemd reports failed units

rules.impact: Unexpected credentials for these accounts can provide unrestricted host access.
rules.passed: No additional UID 0 accounts were found
rules.rationale: UID 0 accounts have root-equivalent operating-system authority.
rules.recommendation: Verify each account's ownership and necessity, then remove or reassign unexpected UID 0 identities through an approved workflow.
rules.title: Additional accounts have UID 0

rules.impact: Other findings may be absent or have lower confidence.
rules.rationale: Missing, failed, or truncated collectors reduce the completeness of the audit evidence.
rules.recommendation: Review collector errors and platform dependencies before treating the audit as complete.
rules.title: Inventory collection was incomplete

rules.impact: Guessed, reused, or disclosed passwords may permit remote access.
rules.passed: SSH password authentication is disabled for auditor identities
rules.rationale: Password-capable SSH authentication expands the remote credential attack surface.
rules.recommendation: Disable password and keyboard-interactive authentication for auditor identities after validating key access.
rules.title: SSH permits password-capable authentication

rules.impact: A compromised root credential provides immediate unrestricted host authority.
rules.passed: Direct SSH root login is disabled
rules.rationale: Direct root SSH authentication bypasses attribution through a named administrative account.
rules.recommendation: Set PermitRootLogin to no after validating an alternate administrative recovery path.
rules.title: SSH permits direct root login

rules.impact: A compromised auditor credential may gain a general-purpose command environment.
rules.rationale: An interactive shell increases the impact of an SSH command-boundary failure.
rules.recommendation: Use a non-interactive shell together with an SSH forced command for report-only identities.
rules.title: Auditor identities have interactive shells

rules.impact: Modification of an endpoint can turn the narrow sudo capability into arbitrary root execution.
rules.passed: Report endpoints are owned by root and not writable by other users
rules.rationale: The sudo boundary trusts fixed report endpoint files executed as root.
rules.recommendation: Install every endpoint as root-owned and remove group and other write permissions.
rules.title: Report endpoint integrity is not enforced

rules.impact: An attacker may replace trusted keys or influence the report identity's login environment.
rules.passed: Auditor homes and authorized_keys have restrictive ownership and modes
rules.rationale: Writable account homes or key files can let another identity alter SSH authentication behavior.
rules.recommendation: Restore account ownership and remove group or other write access; restrict authorized_keys to its owner.
rules.title: Auditor account paths have unsafe permissions
